nodes.name: Auxiliary construction
nodes.function_signature: (states, goal) → (states + helper_object)
nodes.description: Introduce a helper object whose structure forces the desired conclusion. Distinct from reduce-to-canonical-form (which simplifies) because this ADDS structure.
nodes.examples_note: Ptolemy's point K; Brouwer retraction; Frey curve; Archimedes' auxiliary triangles.

nodes.name: Conjecture refinement
nodes.function_signature: (rough_conjecture, counterexamples) → (refined_conjecture)
nodes.description: Modify a conjecture to exclude known failure modes or add missing preconditions. Distinct from verify-on-special-cases — that tests, this refines.
nodes.examples_note: Legendre's refinement of Gauss's PNT conjecture; Kepler's third law via successive refinement on Tycho's data.

nodes.name: Reductio ad absurdum
nodes.function_signature: (proposition P) → (proof of ¬P via assuming P and deriving contradiction)
nodes.description: Assume the statement's negation; derive a contradiction; conclude. Distinct from infinite descent (which is number-theoretic minimal-counterexample).
nodes.examples_note: Cantor uncountability; Gödel incompleteness contradiction step; Turing halting; Brouwer no-retraction.

nodes.name: Projection to subspace
nodes.function_signature: (ambient_space, subspace) → (image_in_subspace)
nodes.description: Map from a higher-dimensional space to a lower-dimensional subspace along a specified direction. Inverse / cousin of t_raise_dimension.
nodes.examples_note: Desargues step 3 (3D → 2D back-projection); Radon transform; Plücker embedding back-projection.

nodes.name: Sheaf cohomology bridge
nodes.function_signature: (divisor/sheaf) → (cohomology classes H^i)
nodes.description: Specialization of the analysis-algebra-topology bridge: compute H^i(X, F) and extract Euler characteristic or related invariants.

nodes.name: K-theoretic index bridge
nodes.function_signature: (elliptic_operator) → (index class in K-theory)
nodes.description: Lift an elliptic operator to a K-theory class and recover the analytic index via pushforward.
nodes.examples_note: Atiyah–Singer index theorem; families index theorem.

nodes.name: Heights / Galois representation bridge
nodes.function_signature: (abelian_variety or elliptic curve) → (Galois rep + height data)
nodes.description: Bridge Diophantine geometry to Galois theory via ell-adic representations and canonical heights.

nodes.name: Level-lowering bridge (Ribet)
nodes.function_signature: (mod-l Galois rep at level N) → (rep at level N/p)
nodes.description: Given a Galois rep coming from a modular form at level N with extra congruence, show it comes from level N/p.
nodes.examples_note: Ribet's theorem; epsilon conjecture; key step in Wiles' FLT.

nodes.name: Transference bridge
nodes.function_signature: (dense subset of pseudorandom majorant) → (inherited structural result)
nodes.description: Transfer a structural theorem (e.g., Szemerédi) from dense integers to a pseudorandom sparse subset via relative-density machinery.
nodes.examples_note: Green–Tao APs in primes; Conlon–Fox–Zhao sparse pseudorandomness.

nodes.description: Iter-3 imported theorem (s_birkhoff_grothendieck).

nodes.name: holomorphic bundle on P1
nodes.description: Iter-3 imported state (s_holomorphic_bundle_on_P1).

nodes.name: maximal subbundle
nodes.description: Iter-3 imported state (s_maximal_subbundle).

nodes.name: inductive splitting into line bundles
nodes.description: Iter-3 imported state (s_inductive_splitting_into_line_bundles).

nodes.name: Clifford's theorem on special divisors
nodes.description: Iter-3 imported theorem (s_clifford_theorem).

nodes.name: special divisor setup
nodes.description: Iter-3 imported state (s_special_divisor_setup).

nodes.name: multiplication map of linear systems
nodes.description: Iter-3 imported state (s_multiplication_map_of_linear_systems).

nodes.name: clifford inequality
nodes.description: Iter-3 imported state (s_clifford_inequality).

nodes.name: Bernoulli number
nodes.description: A sequence of rational numbers arising in the Taylor expansion of t/(e^t − 1) and connected to values of the Riemann zeta function at negative integers.

nodes.name: Brauer group
nodes.description: The group of equivalence classes of central simple algebras over a field, under tensor product.

nodes.name: Composition series
nodes.description: A maximal chain of subnormal subgroups from the trivial subgroup to the whole group, with each factor being simple.

nodes.name: Dedekind domain
nodes.description: An integral domain that is Noetherian, integrally closed, and in which every nonzero prime ideal is maximal.

nodes.name: Derivation (algebra)
nodes.description: A linear map D on an algebra satisfying the Leibniz rule D(ab) = D(a)b + aD(b).

nodes.name: Determinant
nodes.description: The unique alternating multilinear function on the columns of a square matrix that equals one on the identity, measuring signed volume scaling.

nodes.name: Discriminant
nodes.description: An algebraic invariant of a polynomial or number field encoding ramification information and separability of roots.

nodes.name: Endomorphism ring
nodes.description: The ring of all endomorphisms of an abelian group or module, with addition and composition as operations.

nodes.name: Ext functor
nodes.description: The right derived functors of Hom, classifying extensions of modules and measuring failure of exactness.

nodes.name: Exterior algebra
nodes.description: The quotient of the tensor algebra by the ideal generated by v ⊗ v, yielding an algebra with anticommutative multiplication.

nodes.name: Flat module
nodes.description: A module M over a ring such that tensoring with M preserves exact sequences.

nodes.name: Free group
nodes.description: The group on a set of generators with no relations other than the group axioms.

nodes.name: Free module
nodes.description: A module isomorphic to a direct sum of copies of the base ring, possessing a basis.

nodes.name: Frobenius endomorphism
nodes.description: The ring endomorphism x → x^p in characteristic p, fundamental to finite field and algebraic geometry structure theory.

nodes.name: Global field
nodes.description: Either a number field or a function field of a curve over a finite field.

nodes.name: Graded ring
nodes.description: A ring decomposed as a direct sum of abelian groups indexed by integers, with multiplication respecting the grading.

nodes.name: Gröbner basis
nodes.description: A generating set of a polynomial ideal enabling algorithmic solution of the ideal membership problem.

nodes.name: Grothendieck group
nodes.description: The universal abelian group K₀ associated to a commutative monoid by formally adjoining inverses.

nodes.name: Group algebra
nodes.description: The algebra over a field whose basis elements are the group elements and whose multiplication extends the group operation linearly.

nodes.name: Hensel's lemma
nodes.description: A simple root of a polynomial modulo a prime can be lifted uniquely to a root in the p-adic integers.

nodes.name: Hilbert class field
nodes.description: The maximal unramified abelian extension of a number field, whose Galois group is isomorphic to the ideal class group.

nodes.name: Hopf algebra
nodes.description: A bialgebra equipped with an antipode map, axiomatizing group-like objects in a symmetric monoidal category.

nodes.name: Ideal class group
nodes.description: The quotient of fractional ideals by principal ideals of a number field, measuring deviation from unique factorization.

nodes.name: Injective module
nodes.description: A module I such that every homomorphism from a submodule extends to the whole module.

nodes.name: Integral closure
nodes.description: The set of elements in a ring extension satisfying a monic polynomial over the base ring, forming a subring.

nodes.name: Integral domain
nodes.description: A nonzero commutative ring with no zero divisors.

nodes.name: Koszul complex
nodes.description: A chain complex associated to a sequence of ring elements, used to compute Tor/Ext and characterize regular sequences.

nodes.name: Local ring
nodes.description: A ring with a unique maximal ideal.

nodes.name: Localization (ring theory)
nodes.description: The construction inverting a multiplicative subset of a commutative ring, generalizing passage from ℤ to ℚ.

nodes.name: Morita equivalence
nodes.description: Two rings are Morita equivalent iff their module categories are equivalent, realized by tensoring with a bimodule.

nodes.name: Nilpotent group
nodes.description: A group whose lower central series terminates at the trivial subgroup in finitely many steps.

nodes.name: p-adic number
nodes.description: An element of the completion of ℚ with respect to the p-adic absolute value, forming a locally compact non-archimedean field.

nodes.name: Permutation group
nodes.description: A group acting faithfully on a set, realized as a subgroup of the symmetric group.

nodes.name: Picard group
nodes.description: The group of isomorphism classes of invertible sheaves on an algebraic variety, under tensor product.

nodes.name: Radical (Jacobson)
nodes.description: The intersection of all maximal left ideals of a ring, consisting of elements annihilating all simple modules.

nodes.name: Ring of integers
nodes.description: The integral closure of ℤ in a number field, a Dedekind domain serving as the arithmetic foundation of the field.

nodes.name: Root system
nodes.description: A finite set of vectors in a Euclidean space satisfying reflection and integrality axioms, classifying semisimple Lie algebras.

nodes.name: Semi-direct product
nodes.description: A group constructed from a normal subgroup and a complement with a specified conjugation action.

nodes.name: Solvable group
nodes.description: A group possessing a subnormal series whose successive quotients are all abelian.

nodes.name: Tor functor
nodes.description: The left derived functors of the tensor product, measuring failure of tensoring to preserve exactness.

nodes.name: Transcendence degree
nodes.description: The cardinality of a maximal algebraically independent subset of a field extension.

nodes.name: Universal enveloping algebra
nodes.description: The associative algebra U(𝔤) associated to a Lie algebra through which all representations factor.

nodes.name: Witt vectors
nodes.description: A functorial construction lifting a perfect field of characteristic p to a complete DVR of characteristic zero.

nodes.name: Adèle ring
nodes.description: The restricted product of all completions of a global field, providing a single topological ring unifying all local data.

nodes.name: Idèle group
nodes.description: The group of units of the adèle ring, whose quotient by global units governs class field theory.

nodes.name: Noether normalization lemma
nodes.description: Every finitely generated algebra over a field is a finite extension of a polynomial subring.

nodes.name: Cohen–Macaulay ring
nodes.description: A Noetherian local ring in which the depth equals the Krull dimension.

nodes.name: Dynkin diagram
nodes.description: A graph encoding the simple roots and their angles in a root system, classifying simple Lie algebras and finite reflection groups.

nodes.name: Weyl group
nodes.description: The finite group generated by reflections associated to the root system of a semisimple Lie algebra.

nodes.name: Cartan subalgebra
nodes.description: A maximal abelian self-normalizing subalgebra of a semisimple Lie algebra, whose simultaneous eigenspaces yield the root space decomposition.

nodes.name: σ-algebra
nodes.description: A collection of subsets closed under complementation and countable unions, serving as the domain of a measure.

nodes.name: Borel σ-algebra
nodes.description: The smallest σ-algebra containing all open sets of a topological space.

nodes.name: Hausdorff measure
nodes.description: A family of outer measures parametrized by dimension, generalizing length/area/volume to fractional dimensions.

nodes.name: Radon measure
nodes.description: A locally finite inner-regular Borel measure on a locally compact Hausdorff space.

nodes.name: Fréchet space
nodes.description: A complete metrizable locally convex space whose topology is induced by a countable family of seminorms.

nodes.name: Dual space
nodes.description: The space of all continuous linear functionals on a topological vector space.

nodes.name: C*-algebra
nodes.description: A Banach algebra with involution satisfying ‖a*a‖ = ‖a‖², abstractly characterizing norm-closed *-subalgebras of B(H).

nodes.name: Spectrum (operator)
nodes.description: The set of λ ∈ ℂ for which T − λI lacks a bounded inverse, decomposing into point, continuous, and residual spectrum.

nodes.name: Schwartz space
nodes.description: The Fréchet space of rapidly decreasing smooth functions on ℝⁿ, the natural domain for the Fourier transform.

nodes.name: Green's function
nodes.description: The integral kernel of the inverse of a linear differential operator, encoding the response to a point source.

nodes.name: Gamma function
nodes.description: The meromorphic function Γ(s) = ∫₀^∞ t^{s−1}e^{−t}dt extending the factorial to complex numbers, with poles at non-positive integers.

nodes.name: Analytic continuation
nodes.description: The unique extension of a holomorphic function beyond its original domain of definition, following from the identity theorem.

nodes.name: Normal distribution
nodes.description: The probability distribution with density (2πσ²)^{−1/2}exp(−(x−μ)²/(2σ²)), characterized by the central limit theorem.

nodes.name: Bessel function
nodes.description: Solutions of Bessel's differential equation x²y″+xy′+(x²−ν²)y=0 arising in cylindrical and spherical wave problems.

nodes.name: Legendre polynomial
nodes.description: Orthogonal polynomials on [−1,1] with weight 1 satisfying Legendre's ODE, arising as zonal spherical harmonics.

nodes.name: Hermite polynomial
nodes.description: Orthogonal polynomials on ℝ with Gaussian weight e^{−x²}, eigenfunctions of the quantum harmonic oscillator.

nodes.name: Orthogonal polynomial
nodes.description: A sequence of polynomials orthogonal with respect to a weight function, satisfying a three-term recurrence relation.

nodes.name: Bernstein polynomial
nodes.description: The polynomial B_n(f;x) = Σ f(k/n)C(n,k)x^k(1−x)^{n−k} giving a constructive proof of the Weierstrass approximation theorem.

nodes.name: Stirling's formula
nodes.description: n! ~ √(2πn)(n/e)ⁿ, the fundamental asymptotic approximation for the factorial function.

nodes.name: Elliptic integral
nodes.description: An integral of the form ∫R(x,√P(x))dx where P has degree 3 or 4, not expressible in elementary functions.

nodes.name: Normal space
nodes.description: A topological space in which any two disjoint closed sets can be separated by disjoint open neighborhoods.

nodes.name: Metrization theorem (Nagata–Smirnov)
nodes.description: A topological space is metrizable iff it is regular, Hausdorff, and has a countably locally finite basis.

nodes.name: Quotient space (topology)
nodes.description: The space obtained by identifying points via an equivalence relation, with the finest topology making the projection continuous.

nodes.name: Cofibration
nodes.description: A continuous map satisfying the homotopy extension property.

nodes.name: Fibration
nodes.description: A continuous map satisfying the homotopy lifting property, yielding a long exact sequence of homotopy groups.

nodes.name: Cellular homology
nodes.description: Homology computed from the chain complex of relative homology of successive skeleta of a CW complex.

nodes.name: Cohomology ring
nodes.description: The graded ring structure on cohomology given by the cup product, a fundamental invariant of spaces.

nodes.name: Čech cohomology
nodes.description: Cohomology defined via open covers and nerve simplicial complexes, agreeing with singular cohomology on paracompact spaces.

nodes.name: Classifying space
nodes.description: A space BG whose principal G-bundles over X are classified by homotopy classes [X, BG].

nodes.name: Characteristic class
nodes.description: A cohomology class functorially associated to a vector bundle measuring non-triviality, e.g. Chern, Pontryagin, Stiefel–Whitney.

nodes.name: Obstruction theory
nodes.description: A systematic use of cohomology classes to determine extendability of maps on CW skeleta.

nodes.name: K-theory (topological)
nodes.description: Generalized cohomology theory from stable isomorphism classes of vector bundles, with Bott periodicity of period 2 or 8.

nodes.name: Cobordism
nodes.description: The equivalence relation on manifolds where two are cobordant if their disjoint union bounds a manifold of one higher dimension.

nodes.name: Knot theory
nodes.description: The study of embeddings of circles in 3-space up to ambient isotopy, classified by polynomial and group invariants.

nodes.name: Jones polynomial
nodes.description: A Laurent polynomial knot invariant from Hecke algebra representations, distinguishing knots the Alexander polynomial cannot.

nodes.name: Connection (differential geometry)
nodes.description: A structure on a bundle specifying parallel transport and covariant differentiation of sections along curves.

nodes.name: Levi-Civita connection
nodes.description: The unique torsion-free metric-compatible connection on a Riemannian manifold.

nodes.name: Holonomy group
nodes.description: The group of parallel transport maps around loops at a point, classifying connections by the Ambrose–Singer theorem.

nodes.name: Riemann curvature tensor
nodes.description: The (1,3)-tensor measuring failure of second covariant derivatives to commute, encoding all intrinsic curvature.

nodes.name: Exponential map (Riemannian)
nodes.description: The map from the tangent space sending a vector to the geodesic endpoint, a local diffeomorphism near the origin.

nodes.name: Jacobi field
nodes.description: A vector field along a geodesic satisfying the Jacobi equation, detecting conjugate points.

nodes.name: Stokes' theorem
nodes.description: The integral of a differential form over the boundary of an oriented manifold equals the integral of its exterior derivative.

nodes.name: Exterior derivative
nodes.description: The unique linear operator on forms satisfying the Leibniz rule and d² = 0, generalizing grad, curl, div.

nodes.name: Hodge theory
nodes.description: Every de Rham cohomology class on a compact Riemannian manifold has a unique harmonic representative.

nodes.name: Hodge star operator
nodes.description: The linear map on k-forms to (n−k)-forms induced by the metric and orientation.

nodes.name: Immersion
nodes.description: A differentiable map whose differential is injective at every point, a local embedding allowing self-intersections.

nodes.name: Submersion
nodes.description: A differentiable map whose differential is surjective at every point.

nodes.name: Transversality
nodes.description: Two submanifolds intersect transversally when their tangent spaces span the ambient tangent space at each intersection point.

nodes.name: Tangent bundle
nodes.description: The vector bundle over a smooth manifold whose fiber at each point is the tangent space.

nodes.name: Cotangent bundle
nodes.description: The dual of the tangent bundle, whose sections are differential 1-forms and which carries a canonical symplectic structure.

nodes.name: Foliation
nodes.description: A decomposition of a manifold into connected immersed submanifolds of constant dimension.

nodes.name: Algebraic variety
nodes.description: The zero locus of a set of polynomial equations in affine or projective space.

nodes.name: Zariski topology
nodes.description: The topology on varieties/schemes whose closed sets are algebraic subsets, coarser than the Euclidean topology.

nodes.name: Ample line bundle
nodes.description: A line bundle some power of which embeds the variety into projective space.

nodes.name: Étale cohomology
nodes.description: Cohomology using the étale topology, providing ℓ-adic groups as an algebraic analogue of singular cohomology.

nodes.name: Intersection theory
nodes.description: The formalism assigning intersection multiplicities to algebraic cycles, yielding a ring structure on the Chow group.

nodes.name: Chow group
nodes.description: The group of algebraic cycles modulo rational equivalence, the algebro-geometric analogue of homology.

nodes.name: Kodaira dimension
nodes.description: An integer invariant measuring growth of pluricanonical sections, providing the coarsest birational classification.

nodes.name: Canonical bundle
nodes.description: The line bundle of top-degree holomorphic forms, governing birational classification of varieties.

nodes.name: Calabi–Yau manifold
nodes.description: A compact Kähler manifold with trivial canonical bundle admitting Ricci-flat metrics by Yau's theorem.

nodes.name: Maximum likelihood estimation
nodes.description: Estimating parameters by maximizing the likelihood function over the parameter space.

nodes.name: Neyman–Pearson lemma
nodes.description: The likelihood ratio test is the most powerful test at any given significance level for simple hypotheses.

nodes.name: Fisher information
nodes.description: The variance of the score function, measuring information an observable carries about an unknown parameter.

nodes.name: Cramér–Rao inequality
nodes.description: The variance of any unbiased estimator is bounded below by the reciprocal of the Fisher information.

nodes.name: Conditional expectation
nodes.description: The essentially unique measurable function satisfying the tower property, giving the expected value given a sub-σ-algebra.

nodes.name: Kolmogorov axioms
nodes.description: The foundational axioms defining probability as a countably additive non-negative normalized measure.

nodes.name: Wiener process
nodes.description: A continuous-time process with independent stationary Gaussian increments and continuous paths, the rigorous Brownian motion.

nodes.name: Itô calculus
nodes.description: Stochastic calculus for semimartingales with the Itô integral and formula featuring a second-order correction term.

nodes.name: Stochastic differential equation
nodes.description: A differential equation driven by Brownian motion, with solutions interpreted via Itô or Stratonovich integration.

nodes.name: Lévy process
nodes.description: A process with independent stationary increments continuous in probability, characterized by the Lévy–Khintchine formula.

nodes.name: Kalman filter
nodes.description: A recursive algorithm producing optimal linear state estimates for linear dynamical systems from noisy observations.

nodes.name: Propositional calculus
nodes.description: The formal system of logic dealing with propositions connected by logical connectives.

nodes.name: Predicate calculus
nodes.description: First-order logic extending propositional calculus with quantifiers and predicates over a domain.

nodes.name: Transfinite induction
nodes.description: Proof method extending induction to well-ordered sets via successor and limit ordinal cases.

nodes.name: Cardinal number
nodes.description: An equivalence class of sets under bijection measuring size, extended to the transfinite via the aleph hierarchy.

nodes.name: Ordinal number
nodes.description: A transitive set well-ordered by membership, extending the natural numbers to represent order types of well-orderings.

nodes.name: Zorn's lemma
nodes.description: Every partially ordered set in which every chain has an upper bound contains a maximal element.

nodes.name: Wave equation
nodes.description: The hyperbolic PDE u_tt = c²Δu describing wave propagation, solved by d'Alembert (1D) or Kirchhoff (3D) formulas.

nodes.name: Finite element method
nodes.description: Numerical PDE solving by discretizing into elements and approximating with piecewise polynomial basis functions.

nodes.name: Runge–Kutta method
nodes.description: Iterative ODE solvers evaluating the vector field at intermediate stages within each time step.

nodes.name: Galerkin method
nodes.description: Converting a continuous operator equation to a discrete problem by projecting onto a finite-dimensional subspace.

nodes.name: Pontryagin maximum principle
nodes.description: The optimal control maximizes the Hamiltonian along the optimal trajectory with respect to adjoint variables.

nodes.name: Linear programming
nodes.description: Optimization of a linear objective subject to linear constraints, solvable in polynomial time.

nodes.name: Simplex method
nodes.description: An LP algorithm traversing vertices of the feasible polytope along improving edges.

nodes.name: Hamilton–Jacobi equation
nodes.description: A first-order nonlinear PDE linking Hamiltonian mechanics to the calculus of variations.

nodes.name: Catalan number
nodes.description: The sequence C_n = C(2n,n)/(n+1) counting parenthesizations, binary trees, triangulations, and 200+ structures.

nodes.name: Monad (category theory)
nodes.description: An endofunctor with unit and multiplication natural transformations satisfying associativity and unit axioms.

nodes.name: Limit (category theory)
nodes.description: The universal cone over a diagram, generalizing products, equalizers, and pullbacks.

nodes.name: Kan extension
nodes.description: The universal construction extending a functor along another, subsuming limits, colimits, and adjunctions.

nodes.name: Equivalence of categories
nodes.description: A pair of mutually pseudo-inverse functors up to natural isomorphism.

nodes.name: Triangulated category
nodes.description: An additive category with translation functor and distinguished triangles axiomatizing derived and stable homotopy categories.

nodes.name: Group cohomology
nodes.description: Derived functors of the fixed-point functor, classifying group extensions and connecting algebra to topology.

nodes.name: Partially ordered set
nodes.description: A set with a reflexive, antisymmetric, transitive binary relation.

nodes.name: Proof by Contradiction
nodes.function_signature: (Negation of proposition P) → (Contradiction, hence P)
nodes.description: Assume the negation of a statement and derive a logical impossibility.

nodes.name: Proof by Induction
nodes.function_signature: (Base case P(0), Inductive step P(n)→P(n+1)) → (P(n) for all n ∈ ℕ)
nodes.description: Prove a base case and an inductive step to establish a statement for all natural numbers.

nodes.name: Total Order
nodes.description: A partial order in which every pair of elements is comparable.

nodes.name: Cantor Diagonal Argument
nodes.description: The real numbers are uncountable: no surjection ℕ→ℝ exists (Cantor, 1891)

nodes.name: Subfield
nodes.description: A subset of a field that is itself a field under the inherited operations.

nodes.name: Finite Field F_p
nodes.description: The field of integers modulo a prime p.

nodes.name: Basis
nodes.description: A linearly independent spanning set for a vector space.

nodes.name: Dimension
nodes.description: The cardinality of any basis of a vector space (well-defined by basis invariance)

nodes.name: Ring
nodes.description: A set R with two binary operations (+,·) where (R,+) is an abelian group and · is associative and distributes over +.

nodes.name: Ring with Unity
nodes.description: A ring possessing a multiplicative identity element 1.

nodes.name: Ring Homomorphism
nodes.description: A function φ:R→S between rings preserving both addition and multiplication.

nodes.name: Field of Fractions
nodes.description: The localization of an integral domain at its nonzero elements, giving the smallest containing field.

nodes.name: Open Ball
nodes.description: The set B(x,r) = {y∈X : d(x,y)<r} in a metric space.

nodes.name: Open Set (metric)
nodes.description: A set U in a metric space where every point has an open ball contained in U.

nodes.name: Open Set (topological)
nodes.description: A member of the topology τ on a topological space.

nodes.name: Closed Set
nodes.description: The complement of an open set in a topological space.

nodes.name: Neighborhood
nodes.description: An open set containing a given point.

nodes.name: Homeomorphism
nodes.description: A continuous bijection whose inverse is also continuous.

nodes.name: Closure
nodes.description: The smallest closed set containing a given subset of a topological space.

nodes.name: Interior
nodes.description: The largest open set contained in a given subset of a topological space.

nodes.name: Boundary
nodes.description: The set of points in the closure but not the interior of a given set.

nodes.name: Basis for a Topology
nodes.description: A collection of open sets such that every open set is a union of basis elements.

nodes.name: Measure
nodes.description: A countably additive function μ from a σ-algebra to [0,∞] with μ(∅)=0.

nodes.name: Measurable Set
nodes.description: A member of a σ-algebra.

nodes.name: Orbit
nodes.description: The set of all images of a point x under a group action.

nodes.name: Stabilizer
nodes.description: The subgroup of elements in G fixing a given point x under a group action.

nodes.name: Limit of a Sequence
nodes.description: A value L that a sequence approaches: for every ε>0 there exists N such that.

nodes.name: Continuity (ε-δ)
nodes.description: A function f is continuous at a if for every ε>0 there exists δ>0 such that d(x,a)<δ implies d(f(x),f(a))<ε.

nodes.name: Derivative
nodes.description: The limit f'(x) = lim_{h→0} [f(x+h)−f(x)]/h measuring instantaneous rate of change.

nodes.name: Gradient
nodes.description: The vector of all partial derivatives of a scalar-valued function.

nodes.name: Series
nodes.description: A formal sum ∑a_n; its value is the limit of partial sums if convergent.

nodes.name: Event
nodes.description: A measurable subset of the sample space Ω in a probability space.

nodes.name: Expectation
nodes.description: The Lebesgue integral E[X]=∫X dP of a random variable.

nodes.name: Variance
nodes.description: Var(X)=E[(X−E[X])²], measuring the spread of a random variable.

nodes.name: Independence (events)
nodes.description: Events A and B are independent if P(A∩B)=P(A)P(B)

nodes.name: Probability Distribution
nodes.description: The pushforward measure P∘X⁻¹ on ℝ induced by a random variable X.

nodes.name: Martingale
nodes.description: A sequence of random variables where the conditional expectation of the next value given the past equals the current value.

nodes.name: Chart
nodes.description: A homeomorphism from an open subset of a manifold to an open subset of ℝⁿ.

nodes.name: Atlas
nodes.description: A collection of charts covering the entire manifold with compatible transition maps.

nodes.name: k-Form
nodes.description: A differential form of degree k, i.e., a section of Λ^k(T*M)

nodes.name: geodesic
nodes.description: A curve gamma(t) that locally minimizes length, equivalently satisfying the equation nabla_{gamma'} gamma' = 0.

nodes.name: complex manifold
nodes.description: A manifold with holomorphic transition functions, carrying a complex structure.

nodes.name: Volume Form
nodes.description: A nowhere-vanishing n-form on an n-dimensional orientable manifold.

nodes.name: Embedding
nodes.description: A smooth injective immersion that is a homeomorphism onto its image.

nodes.name: Genus
nodes.description: The topological invariant counting the number of handles of a compact Riemann surface.

nodes.name: Torus (complex)
nodes.description: A Riemann surface of genus 1, realized as ℂ/Λ for a lattice Λ.

nodes.name: Orbifold
nodes.description: A generalization of a manifold locally modeled on quotients ℝⁿ/G by finite group actions.

nodes.name: Orbifold Point
nodes.description: A point in an orbifold whose local model has a nontrivial isotropy group.

nodes.name: Fiber
nodes.description: The space F that each fiber π⁻¹(b) is homeomorphic to.

nodes.name: Section
nodes.description: A continuous (or smooth) map s:B→E with π∘s=id_B, choosing an element in each fiber.

nodes.name: Curvature of a Connection
nodes.description: The 2-form measuring the failure of a connection's horizontal distribution to be integrable.

nodes.name: Flat Connection
nodes.description: A connection whose curvature vanishes identically.

nodes.name: Covariant Derivative
nodes.description: The derivative operator ∇ along a vector field, induced by a connection on a vector bundle.

nodes.name: Reynolds Number
nodes.description: The dimensionless ratio Re=UL/ν characterizing the relative importance of inertial to viscous forces.

nodes.name: Knot
nodes.description: A smooth embedding of S¹ into ℝ³ (or S³), considered up to ambient isotopy.

nodes.name: Knot Invariant
nodes.description: A quantity assigned to a knot that is unchanged by ambient isotopy.

nodes.name: Unknot
nodes.description: The trivial knot, equivalent to a standard circle in ℝ³.

nodes.name: Trefoil Knot
nodes.description: The simplest nontrivial knot, with three crossings.

nodes.name: Knot Diagram
nodes.description: A planar projection of a knot with over/under crossing information.

nodes.name: Link
nodes.description: A smooth embedding of several disjoint copies of S¹ into ℝ³.

nodes.name: Reidemeister Moves
nodes.description: Three local moves on knot diagrams that generate all ambient isotopies between diagrams.

nodes.name: Matroid
nodes.description: A finite set E with a collection of independent subsets satisfying the hereditary and augmentation axioms, abstracting linear independence.

nodes.name: Matroid Circuit
nodes.description: A minimal dependent set in a matroid.

nodes.name: Dual Matroid
nodes.description: The matroid M* on the same ground set where bases are complements of bases of M.

nodes.name: Graphic Matroid
nodes.description: The matroid on the edges of a graph where independent sets are acyclic edge sets (forests)

nodes.name: Representable Matroid
nodes.description: A matroid realizable as the column matroid of a matrix over some field.

nodes.name: Morphism
nodes.description: An arrow f:A→B between objects in a category.

nodes.name: Isomorphism (category)
nodes.description: A morphism with a two-sided inverse in a category.

nodes.name: Product (categorical)
nodes.description: An object A×B with projections satisfying the universal property of products.

nodes.name: Coproduct
nodes.description: An object A⊔B with inclusions satisfying the universal property dual to products.

nodes.name: Colimit
nodes.description: A universal cocone under a diagram, dual to limit, generalizing coproducts, coequalizers, and pushouts.

nodes.name: Schwartz Distribution
nodes.description: A continuous linear functional on the space of test functions.

nodes.name: Dirac Delta Distribution
nodes.description: The distribution δ_a defined by δ_a(φ)=φ(a), generalizing the point mass.

nodes.name: Distributional Derivative
nodes.description: The derivative of a distribution T defined by T'(φ)=−T(φ'), extending differentiation to non-differentiable objects.

nodes.name: Convolution
nodes.description: The operation (f*g)(x)=∫f(x−y)g(y)dy combining two functions.

nodes.name: Tensor Product of Modules
nodes.description: For R-modules M,N: M⊗_R N, the universal object for R-bilinear maps.

nodes.name: Tensor
nodes.description: An element of a tensor product; a multilinear functional on products of vector spaces and their duals.

nodes.name: Tensor Field
nodes.description: A smooth assignment of a tensor to each point of a manifold.

nodes.name: Spinor
nodes.description: An element of a representation of the Spin group; a square root of a geometry.

nodes.name: Quaternions ℍ
nodes.description: The 4-dimensional real Clifford algebra with basis {1,i,j,k} and i²=j²=k²=ijk=−1.

nodes.name: Grassmannian Gr(k,n)
nodes.description: The space of all k-dimensional linear subspaces of an n-dimensional vector space.

nodes.name: Plücker Embedding
nodes.description: The embedding of Gr(k,n) into projective space via exterior products.

nodes.name: Mirror Symmetry (Calabi-Yau)
nodes.description: A duality pairing Calabi-Yau manifolds in which the complex and symplectic geometries are exchanged.

nodes.name: Modular Arithmetic
nodes.description: The arithmetic of integers modulo n, forming the ring ℤ/nℤ.

nodes.name: Quadratic Residue
nodes.description: An integer a is a quadratic residue mod p if a≡x² (mod p) for some x.

nodes.name: j-Invariant
nodes.description: The invariant j(E) classifying elliptic curves over algebraically closed fields up to isomorphism.

nodes.name: Lattice (in ℂ)
nodes.description: A discrete subgroup Λ=ℤω₁+ℤω₂ of ℂ with ℂ/Λ a complex torus.

nodes.name: Weierstrass ℘-function
nodes.description: The doubly periodic meromorphic function ℘(z;Λ) uniformizing an elliptic curve.

nodes.name: Mandelbrot set
nodes.description: M = {c ∈ C : the orbit of 0 under z² + c is bounded}, the parameter space of quadratic polynomials.

nodes.name: Julia set
nodes.description: J(f) = ∂{z : f^n(z) → ∞} for a rational map f: C → C, the boundary of the basin of attraction of infinity.

nodes.name: Filled Julia Set K_c
nodes.description: The set of all z_0∈ℂ for which the orbit of z under z↦z²+c is bounded.

nodes.name: Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE)
nodes.description: An equation involving a function of one variable and its derivatives: F(x,y,y',…,y^{(n)})=0.

nodes.name: Linear ODE
nodes.description: An ODE where the unknown function and its derivatives appear linearly.

nodes.name: Autonomous ODE
nodes.description: An ODE dy/dt=f(y) where f does not depend explicitly on t.

nodes.name: Flow
nodes.description: The one-parameter family φ_t of diffeomorphisms generated by the solutions of an autonomous ODE.

nodes.name: Equilibrium Point
nodes.description: A point y_0 where f(y_0)=0 in dy/dt=f(y), so the constant function y(t)=y_0 is a solution.

nodes.name: Partial Differential Equation (PDE)
nodes.description: An equation involving partial derivatives of a function of several variables.

nodes.name: Elliptic PDE
nodes.description: A PDE whose principal symbol is positive-definite (e.g., Laplace's equation Δu=0)

nodes.name: Parabolic PDE
nodes.description: A PDE whose principal symbol is degenerate in one direction (e.g., heat equation u_t=Δu)

nodes.name: Hyperbolic PDE
nodes.description: A PDE whose principal symbol has signature (n−1,1) (e.g., wave equation u_{tt}=c²Δu)

nodes.name: Lagrange Multipliers
nodes.function_signature: (Function f, Constraint g=0) → (Critical points of f subject to g=0)
nodes.description: A method for finding extrema of f(x) subject to constraints g(x)=0 by solving ∇f=λ∇g.

nodes.name: Convex Optimization
nodes.function_signature: (Convex function f, Convex set C) → (Global minimum of f over C)
nodes.description: Minimization of a convex function over a convex set, where every local minimum is global.

nodes.name: Bernoulli Distribution
nodes.description: The distribution of a binary random variable taking value 1 with probability p and 0 with probability 1−p.

nodes.name: Binomial Distribution
nodes.description: The distribution of the number of successes in n independent Bernoulli trials.

nodes.name: Poisson Distribution
nodes.description: The distribution P(X=k)=λ^k e^{−λ}/k! modeling rare events with rate λ.

nodes.name: Geometric Distribution
nodes.description: The distribution of the number of trials until the first success in Bernoulli trials.

nodes.name: Chi-Squared Distribution
nodes.description: The distribution of ∑X_i² where X_i are i.i.d. standard normal random variables.

nodes.name: Student's t-Distribution
nodes.description: The distribution of Z/√(V/k) where Z~N(0,1) and V~χ²(k) are independent.

nodes.name: Multivariate Normal Distribution
nodes.description: The joint distribution N(μ,Σ) of a random vector with density determined by mean μ and covariance matrix Σ.

nodes.name: Prior Distribution
nodes.description: A probability distribution encoding beliefs about a parameter before observing data.

nodes.name: Posterior Distribution
nodes.description: The updated probability distribution of a parameter after incorporating observed data via Bayes' theorem.

nodes.name: Bayesian Inference
nodes.function_signature: (Prior π(θ), Likelihood L(x|θ), Data x) → (Posterior π(θ|x))
nodes.description: Updating beliefs about parameters via posterior ∝ likelihood × prior.

nodes.name: Conjugate Prior
nodes.description: A prior distribution whose posterior under a given likelihood belongs to the same family.

nodes.name: Wavelet
nodes.description: A function ψ∈L²(ℝ) with zero mean, used to generate a basis via translations and dilations.

nodes.name: Haar Wavelet
nodes.description: The simplest wavelet, a piecewise constant function taking values ±1 on subintervals of [0,1].

nodes.name: Multiresolution Analysis
nodes.description: A nested sequence of closed subspaces V_j of L²(ℝ) with scaling and density properties.

nodes.name: Daubechies Wavelet
nodes.description: A family of compactly supported orthonormal wavelets with maximal smoothness for their support size (Daubechies, 1988)

nodes.name: Block Design
nodes.description: A collection of subsets (blocks) of a finite set satisfying prescribed intersection properties.

nodes.name: t-Design
nodes.description: A block design where every t-element subset is contained in the same number of blocks.

nodes.name: Steiner System S(t,k,n)
nodes.description: A t-design with block size k on n points where every t-subset appears in exactly one block.

nodes.name: Linear Code
nodes.description: A code that is a linear subspace of F_q^n.

nodes.name: Hamming Distance
nodes.description: The number of coordinates in which two codewords differ, defining a metric on F^n.

nodes.name: Hamming Code
nodes.description: A perfect single-error-correcting linear code with parameters [2^r−1, 2^r−r−1, 3].

nodes.name: Minimum Distance
nodes.description: The smallest Hamming distance between any two distinct codewords in a code.

nodes.name: Natural Logarithm
nodes.description: The inverse function ln(x)=∫_1^x dt/t, the unique antiderivative of 1/x with ln(1)=0.

nodes.name: Matrix Exponential
nodes.description: exp(A)=∑A^n/n! for a square matrix A, generating the solution to dX/dt=AX.

nodes.name: Spherical Harmonics Y_l^m
nodes.description: The eigenfunctions of the Laplacian on the 2-sphere S², forming an orthonormal basis for L²(S²)

nodes.name: Stirling's Approximation
nodes.description: Γ(n+1)=n!∼√(2πn)(n/e)^n as n→∞ (Stirling)

nodes.name: Transcendental Number
nodes.description: A complex number that is not algebraic, i.e., not a root of any integer polynomial.

nodes.name: Irrationality of √2
nodes.description: The square root of 2 cannot be expressed as a ratio of integers (Pythagoreans, ~500 BCE)

nodes.name: Transcendence of π
nodes.description: π is transcendental (Lindemann, 1882), implying the impossibility of squaring the circle.

nodes.name: Transcendence of e
nodes.description: e is transcendental (Hermite, 1873)

nodes.name: Liouville Numbers
nodes.description: Numbers with irrationality measure ∞, the first explicit examples of transcendental numbers (Liouville, 1844)

nodes.name: Degree of a Field Extension
nodes.description: The dimension [F:K]=dim_K F of F as a vector space over K.

nodes.name: Maximal Ideal
nodes.description: An ideal M such that no ideal lies strictly between M and R.

nodes.name: Radical of an Ideal
nodes.description: √I = {r∈R : r^n∈I for some n}, the set of elements with a power in I.

nodes.name: Affine Scheme Spec(R)
nodes.description: The space of prime ideals of a commutative ring R with the Zariski topology and structure sheaf.

nodes.name: scheme
nodes.description: A locally ringed space locally isomorphic to an affine scheme, the fundamental object of modern algebraic geometry (Grothendieck)

nodes.name: sheaf
nodes.description: A functor assigning to each open set a set/group/ring of sections with compatible restriction maps and gluing.

nodes.name: Morphism of Schemes
nodes.description: A continuous map f:X→Y of underlying spaces with a compatible map of structure sheaves.

nodes.name: Homotopy
nodes.description: A continuous deformation of one map into another; maps f,g:X→Y are homotopic if connected by a continuous family.

nodes.name: Eigenvalue
nodes.description: A scalar λ such that Tv=λv for a nonzero v; an element of the point spectrum of T.

nodes.name: Eigenvector
nodes.description: A nonzero vector v satisfying Tv=λv for an eigenvalue λ of a linear map T.

nodes.name: number_field
nodes.description: A finite field extension of the rational numbers Q.

nodes.name: field_extension_degree
nodes.description: The dimension [K:Q] of a number field K as a vector space over Q.

nodes.name: trace_of_element
nodes.description: The sum of all Galois conjugates of an element of a number field, Tr_{K/Q}(alpha)

nodes.name: discriminant_of_number_field
nodes.description: The determinant of the matrix of traces of products of basis elements of O_K, measuring ramification.

nodes.name: prime_ideal
nodes.description: A proper ideal P of O_K such that if ab is in P then a or b is in P.

nodes.name: fractional_ideal
nodes.description: An O_K-submodule of K that becomes an ideal after multiplication by some nonzero element of O_K.

nodes.name: ideal_class_group
nodes.description: The quotient group of fractional ideals modulo principal ideals, measuring failure of unique factorization.

nodes.name: class_number
nodes.description: The order of the ideal class group of a number field, h_K.

nodes.name: root_of_unity
nodes.description: An algebraic integer zeta such that zeta^n = 1 for some positive integer n.

nodes.name: real_embedding
nodes.description: A field homomorphism from K into the real numbers R.

nodes.name: complex_embedding
nodes.description: A field homomorphism from K into the complex numbers C that is not real.

nodes.name: signature_of_number_field
nodes.description: The pair (r_1, r_2) where r_1 is the number of real embeddings and r_2 the number of conjugate pairs of complex embeddings.

nodes.name: ramification_index
nodes.description: The exponent e_i in the factorization pO_K = P_1^{e_1}...P_g^{e_g} of a rational prime p in O_K.

nodes.name: inertia_degree
nodes.description: The degree [O_K/P_i : Z/pZ] of the residue field extension for a prime ideal P_i above p.

nodes.name: ramified_prime
nodes.description: A rational prime p such that some prime ideal above it in O_K has ramification index greater than 1.

nodes.name: unramified_prime
nodes.description: A rational prime p such that every prime ideal above it in O_K has ramification index 1.

nodes.name: split_prime
nodes.description: A rational prime p that factors into the maximum number of distinct prime ideals in O_K.

nodes.name: inert_prime
nodes.description: A rational prime p that remains prime in O_K, i.e., pO_K is a prime ideal.

nodes.name: decomposition_group
nodes.description: The stabilizer subgroup D(P.

nodes.name: inertia_group
nodes.description: The subgroup I(P.

nodes.name: frobenius_element
nodes.description: The canonical generator of the decomposition group modulo inertia for an unramified prime, acting as x -> x^p on residues.

nodes.name: p_adic_numbers
nodes.description: The completion Q_p of Q with respect to the p-adic absolute value.

nodes.name: p_adic_valuation
nodes.description: The function v_p assigning to each rational number the exponent of p in its prime factorization.

nodes.name: p_adic_absolute_value
nodes.description: The absolute value.

nodes.name: p_adic_integers
nodes.description: The ring Z_p = {x in Q_p :.

nodes.name: completion_of_number_field
nodes.description: The field K_v obtained by completing a number field K at a place v.

nodes.name: place_of_number_field
nodes.description: An equivalence class of absolute values on a number field, either archimedean or non-archimedean.

nodes.name: adele_ring
nodes.description: The restricted direct product of all completions K_v of K with respect to the rings of integers O_{K_v}.

nodes.name: idele_group
nodes.description: The group of invertible elements (units) of the adele ring.

nodes.name: idele_class_group
nodes.description: The quotient C_K = 𝔸_K*/K* of the idèles by the principal idèles; the fundamental object of class field theory.

nodes.name: absolute_value_product_formula
nodes.description: The identity that the product of.

nodes.name: integral_basis
nodes.description: A Z-basis for the ring of integers O_K as a free abelian group of rank [K:Q].

nodes.name: regulator_of_number_field
nodes.description: The absolute value of the determinant of the matrix of logarithms of fundamental units, measuring the lattice of units.

nodes.name: fundamental_units
nodes.description: A maximal set of multiplicatively independent units of O_K, forming a basis for the free part of O_K^*.

nodes.name: class_field
nodes.description: An abelian extension of K corresponding to a given open subgroup of the idele class group via class field theory.

nodes.name: ray_class_group
nodes.description: A generalization of the ideal class group incorporating a modulus, classifying abelian extensions with prescribed ramification.

nodes.name: lattice_in_R_n
nodes.description: A discrete subgroup of R^n isomorphic to Z^n, used in the geometry of numbers applied to number fields.

nodes.name: class_number_formula
nodes.description: Relates the residue of the Dedekind zeta function at s=1 to class number, regulator, discriminant, and number of roots of unity (Dedekind, Dirichlet)

nodes.name: ostrowski_theorem
nodes.description: Every nontrivial absolute value on Q is equivalent to either the usual absolute value or a p-adic absolute value (Ostrowski)

nodes.name: hensels_lemma
nodes.description: A simple root of a polynomial modulo p lifts uniquely to a root in the p-adic integers Z_p (Hensel)

nodes.name: fundamental_identity_efg
nodes.description: For a prime p in a number field K of degree n, the sum of e_i * f_i over all primes above p equals n (Dedekind)

nodes.name: geometry_of_numbers
nodes.function_signature: (Lattice Λ, Convex body K) → (Existence of lattice point in K)
nodes.description: Using geometric properties of lattices and convex bodies to prove existence results about algebraic integers.

nodes.name: localization_at_prime
nodes.function_signature: (Studying a number field one prime at a time by passing to completions K_v.) → (Result)
nodes.description: Studying a number field one prime at a time by passing to completions K_v.

nodes.name: ideal_arithmetic
nodes.function_signature: (Ideals I,J in O_K) → (Product IJ, Factorization, Class group element)
nodes.description: Computing with ideals (multiplication, factorization, class representatives) as a substitute for element factorization.

nodes.name: von_mangoldt_function
nodes.description: The function Lambda(n) = log p if n = p^k and 0 otherwise, weighting primes and prime powers.

nodes.name: chebyshev_functions
nodes.description: The functions theta(x) = sum_{p<=x} log p and psi(x) = sum_{n<=x} Lambda(n)

nodes.name: mobius_function
nodes.description: The function mu(n) = (-1)^k if n is a product of k distinct primes, 0 if n has a squared factor.

nodes.name: principal_character
nodes.description: The Dirichlet character χ₀ with χ₀(n)=1 for gcd(n,d)=1; its L-function has a pole at s=1.

nodes.name: conductor_of_character
nodes.description: The minimal modulus q_0 such that a Dirichlet character factors through (Z/q_0 Z)^*.

nodes.name: primitive_character
nodes.description: A Dirichlet character whose conductor equals its modulus.

nodes.name: trivial_zeros_of_zeta
nodes.description: The zeros of zeta(s) at s = -2, -4, -6, ..., arising from the functional equation.

nodes.name: critical_strip
nodes.description: The region 0 < Re(s) < 1 in the complex plane containing all nontrivial zeros of zeta(s)

nodes.name: critical_line
nodes.description: The line Re(s) = 1/2, conjectured to contain all nontrivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function.

nodes.name: arithmetic_function
nodes.description: A function f: N -> C, the basic object of study in multiplicative and additive number theory.

nodes.name: multiplicative_function
nodes.description: An arithmetic function f with f(mn) = f(m)f(n) whenever gcd(m,n)=1.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution
nodes.description: The product (f*g)(n) = sum_{d.

nodes.name: sieve_of_eratosthenes
nodes.description: The classical method of finding primes by successively removing multiples of each prime.

nodes.name: siegel_zero
nodes.description: A hypothetical real zero of an L-function L(s,chi) very close to s=1 for a real primitive character chi.

nodes.name: li_function
nodes.description: The logarithmic integral Li(x) = integral from 2 to x of dt/log t, the main term in the prime number theorem.

nodes.name: prime_gaps
nodes.description: The differences p_{n+1} - p_n between consecutive primes.

nodes.name: major_arcs
nodes.description: The subsets of [0,1) near rationals a/q with small q, on which generating functions are well approximated.

nodes.name: minor_arcs
nodes.description: The complement of the major arcs in [0,1), where exponential sum estimates are needed.

nodes.name: gaussian_sum
nodes.description: The sum G(chi) = sum_{a mod q} chi(a) e^{2pi i a/q} associated to a Dirichlet character.

nodes.name: kloosterman_sum
nodes.description: The exponential sum S(m,n;c) = sum_{x mod c, gcd(x,c)=1} e^{2pi i(mx+n x^{-1})/c}.

nodes.name: ramanujan_sum
nodes.description: The sum c_q(n) = sum_{a mod q, gcd(a,q)=1} e^{2pi i an/q}.

nodes.name: density_estimate_for_zeros
nodes.description: Upper bounds for the number of zeros of zeta(s) or L(s,chi) in rectangles within the critical strip.

nodes.name: prime_number_theorem
nodes.description: π(x) ~ x/ln(x), or equivalently π(x) ~ Li(x); proved independently by Hadamard and de la Vallée Poussin (1896)

nodes.name: chebyshev_estimates
nodes.description: The bounds c_1 x/log x < pi(x) < c_2 x/log x for explicit constants c_1 < 1 < c_2 (Chebyshev)

nodes.name: dirichlet_l_nonvanishing_at_1
nodes.description: L(1,chi) != 0 for any nonprincipal Dirichlet character chi, key to primes in arithmetic progressions (Dirichlet)

nodes.name: vinogradovs_theorem
nodes.description: Every sufficiently large odd integer is the sum of three primes (Vinogradov, 1937)

nodes.name: warings_problem
nodes.description: Every natural number is the sum of a bounded number g(k) of k-th powers (Hilbert; Hardy-Littlewood asymptotics via circle method)

nodes.name: landau_prime_ideal_theorem
nodes.description: The number of prime ideals of norm at most x in a number field K is asymptotic to x/log x (Landau)

nodes.name: exponential_sum_technique
nodes.function_signature: (Function f, Sum Σe^{2πif(n)}) → (Upper bound on |Σ|)
nodes.description: Bounding sums sum e^{2pi i f(n)} using van der Corput, Weyl differencing, or Vinogradov's method.

nodes.name: selberg_sieve
nodes.function_signature: (Set A, Sifting set P) → (Upper bound on |sifted set|)
nodes.description: Selberg's upper-bound sieve choosing optimal weights to minimize the main term, yielding sharp upper bounds for prime-counting sums.

nodes.name: bruns_sieve
nodes.function_signature: (Set A, Sifting set P) → (Upper and lower bounds via inclusion-exclusion)
nodes.description: Brun's combinatorial sieve using inclusion-exclusion truncation to give upper and lower bounds for sifted sets.

nodes.name: perron_formula
nodes.function_signature: (Dirichlet series F(s)) → (Partial sums of coefficients)
nodes.description: The expression (1/2pi i) integral c-iT to c+iT F(s) x^s/s ds recovering partial sums of Dirichlet series coefficients.

nodes.name: mobius_inversion
nodes.function_signature: (Arithmetic relation g(n)=Σf(d)) → (f(n)=Σμ(d)g(n/d))
nodes.description: The formula f(n) = sum_{d.

nodes.name: contour_integration_in_ant
nodes.function_signature: (Dirichlet series, Contour) → (Asymptotic main term + error)
nodes.description: Shifting contours of integration to extract main terms and error estimates from Dirichlet series.

nodes.name: computational_complexity_class
nodes.description: A class of decision problems (P, NP, BPP, etc.) defined by resource bounds on Turing machines.

nodes.name: probabilistic_algorithm
nodes.description: An algorithm that uses random bits and may give incorrect answers with bounded probability.

nodes.name: deterministic_algorithm
nodes.description: An algorithm that uses no randomness and always produces the correct output.

nodes.name: integer_factorization_problem
nodes.description: The problem of decomposing a composite integer into its prime factors.

nodes.name: primality_testing_problem
nodes.description: The problem of determining whether a given integer is prime or composite.

nodes.name: discrete_logarithm_problem
nodes.description: Given g, h in a group G, find the integer n such that g^n = h, believed to be computationally hard in certain groups.

nodes.name: rsa_cryptosystem
nodes.description: Public-key encryption scheme whose security rests on the difficulty of factoring the product of two large primes (Rivest, Shamir, Adleman)

nodes.name: lattice_in_Z_n
nodes.description: A discrete subgroup of Z^n, the setting for lattice-based computational problems.

nodes.name: smooth_number
nodes.description: An integer all of whose prime factors are below a given bound B, central to subexponential factoring algorithms.

nodes.name: b_smooth
nodes.description: An integer n is B-smooth if all prime factors of n are at most B.

nodes.name: miller_rabin_witness
nodes.description: An integer a that certifies the compositeness of n via the strong pseudoprime test.

nodes.name: pseudoprime
nodes.description: A composite number n that passes a primality test for a given base a, behaving like a prime.

nodes.name: carmichael_number
nodes.description: A composite number n that is a Fermat pseudoprime to every base coprime to n.

nodes.name: factor_base
nodes.description: A set of small primes used to express relations among elements in factoring algorithms.

nodes.name: closest_vector_problem
nodes.description: The problem of finding the lattice point closest to a given target point.

nodes.name: aks_primality_theorem
nodes.description: There exists a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm for primality testing (Agrawal, Kayal, Saxena, 2002)

nodes.name: miller_rabin_correctness
nodes.description: If n is an odd composite, then at least 3/4 of all bases a in [2,n-2] are Miller-Rabin witnesses for n (Rabin)

nodes.name: lenstra_ecm_expected_time
nodes.description: Lenstra's elliptic curve method finds a prime factor p of n in expected time exp(O(sqrt(log p log log p))) (Lenstra)

nodes.name: number_field_sieve_complexity
nodes.description: The general number field sieve factors an integer n in time exp(O((log n)^{1/3} (log log n)^{2/3})), the fastest known general factoring algorithm.

nodes.name: lll_algorithm_properties
nodes.description: The LLL algorithm finds a short vector within a factor of 2^{n/2} of the shortest vector in polynomial time (Lenstra, Lenstra, Lovasz)

nodes.name: trial_division
nodes.function_signature: (Integer n) → (Prime factorization or primality certificate)
nodes.description: Testing divisibility of n by each prime up to sqrt(n), the simplest factoring method.

nodes.name: miller_rabin_test
nodes.function_signature: (Integer n, Witness a) → (Composite or probable prime)
nodes.description: Probabilistic primality test refining the Fermat test using the factorization n-1 = 2^s * d.

nodes.name: aks_algorithm
nodes.function_signature: (Integer n) → (Deterministic primality certificate in polynomial time)
nodes.description: Deterministic polynomial-time primality test based on the polynomial identity (X+a)^n = X^n + a in Z_n[X]/(X^r-1)

nodes.name: sieve_of_eratosthenes_computational
nodes.function_signature: (Bound N) → (List of primes up to N)
nodes.description: Enumerating primes up to N in O(N log log N) time by iteratively marking multiples.

nodes.name: quadratic_sieve
nodes.function_signature: (Composite n) → (Nontrivial factor of n)
nodes.description: Factoring method finding smooth values of (x^2 - n) to build congruences of squares, subexponential time.

nodes.name: number_field_sieve
nodes.function_signature: (Composite n) → (Nontrivial factor of n via algebraic number fields)
nodes.description: The asymptotically fastest known general-purpose factoring algorithm using algebraic number fields to find smooth relations.

nodes.name: pollard_rho_method
nodes.function_signature: (Composite n) → (Factor of n in expected O(n^{1/4}) steps)
nodes.description: Probabilistic factoring algorithm using a pseudo-random sequence and cycle detection, expected time O(p^{1/2}) for smallest factor p.

nodes.name: pollard_p_minus_1
nodes.function_signature: (Composite n with smooth p-1 factor) → (Factor p of n)
nodes.description: Factoring method exploiting smoothness of p-1 for a prime factor p of n.

nodes.name: baby_step_giant_step
nodes.function_signature: (Algorithm computing discrete logarithms in O(sqrt(.) → (Result)
nodes.description: Algorithm computing discrete logarithms in O(sqrt(.

nodes.name: index_calculus
nodes.function_signature: (Generator g in (ℤ/pℤ)*) → (Discrete logarithm in subexponential time)
nodes.description: Subexponential algorithm for discrete logarithms in (Z/pZ)^* using a factor base of small primes.

nodes.name: lll_algorithm
nodes.function_signature: (Lattice basis) → (Reduced basis with short vectors)
nodes.description: Polynomial-time lattice basis reduction algorithm producing a nearly orthogonal basis (Lenstra, Lenstra, Lovasz)

nodes.name: schoof_algorithm
nodes.function_signature: (Elliptic curve E/F_p) → (|E(F_p)| in polynomial time)
nodes.description: Polynomial-time algorithm for counting points on an elliptic curve over F_p by computing the Frobenius trace modulo small primes (Schoof)

nodes.name: projective_space
nodes.description: The space P^n(k) of lines through the origin in k^{n+1}, parametrizing directions.

nodes.name: coordinate_ring
nodes.description: The quotient ring k[x_1,...,x_n]/I(V), the ring of regular functions on an affine variety V.

nodes.name: function_field
nodes.description: The field of fractions of the coordinate ring of an irreducible variety, the field of rational functions.

nodes.name: morphism_of_varieties
nodes.description: A map between varieties given locally by polynomial (regular) functions.

nodes.name: rational_map
nodes.description: A map between varieties defined by ratios of polynomials, possibly undefined on a subvariety.

nodes.name: birational_equivalence
nodes.description: Two varieties are birational if they have isomorphic function fields, equivalent to being isomorphic on dense open subsets.

nodes.name: affine_scheme
nodes.description: Spec(R) for a commutative ring R, the set of prime ideals with the Zariski topology and structure sheaf.

nodes.name: stalk_of_sheaf
nodes.description: The direct limit of sections over all open sets containing a point, giving the local ring at that point.

nodes.name: morphism_of_schemes
nodes.description: A pair (f, f^#) of a continuous map and a sheaf map between locally ringed spaces compatible with the ring structure.

nodes.name: fiber_of_morphism
nodes.description: The preimage of a point under a morphism of schemes, obtained by base change to the residue field.

nodes.name: base_change
nodes.description: The fiber product X x_S T for a morphism X -> S and T -> S, changing the base scheme.

nodes.name: reduced_scheme
nodes.description: A scheme whose local rings have no nilpotent elements.

nodes.name: integral_scheme
nodes.description: A scheme that is both reduced and irreducible.

nodes.name: noetherian_scheme
nodes.description: A scheme admitting a finite covering by spectra of noetherian rings.

nodes.name: locally_free_sheaf
nodes.description: A coherent sheaf locally isomorphic to O_X^n, corresponding to a vector bundle.

nodes.name: divisor
nodes.description: A formal integer linear combination of codimension-1 subvarieties (Weil divisor) or local equations (Cartier divisor)

nodes.name: weil_divisor
nodes.description: A formal Z-linear combination of irreducible codimension-1 subvarieties of a normal variety.

nodes.name: cartier_divisor
nodes.description: A divisor given locally by a single equation, corresponding to a line bundle with a rational section.

nodes.name: linear_equivalence_of_divisors
nodes.description: Two divisors are linearly equivalent if their difference is the divisor of a rational function.

nodes.name: canonical_divisor
nodes.description: A divisor K_X in the linear equivalence class of the sheaf of top differential forms Omega^n_X.

nodes.name: cotangent_sheaf
nodes.description: The sheaf Omega^1_{X/k} of Kahler differentials on a smooth variety X.

nodes.name: tangent_sheaf
nodes.description: The dual of the cotangent sheaf, the sheaf of derivations.

nodes.name: cech_cohomology
nodes.description: A computational approach to sheaf cohomology using open covers and combinatorial cochains.

nodes.name: chow_ring
nodes.description: The ring A^*(X) of algebraic cycles modulo rational equivalence with the intersection product.

nodes.name: hilbert_scheme
nodes.description: The scheme parametrizing closed subschemes of projective space with a given Hilbert polynomial (Grothendieck)

nodes.name: grassmannian
nodes.description: The variety G(k,n) parametrizing k-dimensional linear subspaces of an n-dimensional vector space.

nodes.name: blowup
nodes.description: The birational transformation replacing a subvariety Z of X by the projectivized normal cone, resolving singularities.

nodes.name: exceptional_divisor
nodes.description: The preimage of the blown-up center; a projective space introduced by a blowup.

nodes.name: nef_divisor
nodes.description: A divisor D such that D.C >= 0 for every curve C on X, the closure of the ample cone.

nodes.name: canonical_ring
nodes.description: The graded ring R(X, K_X) = direct sum of H^0(X, mK_X) over m >= 0.

nodes.name: variety_of_general_type
nodes.description: A variety with maximal Kodaira dimension kappa(X) = dim X, having many pluricanonical forms.

nodes.name: fano_variety
nodes.description: A smooth projective variety whose anticanonical divisor -K_X is ample.

nodes.name: calabi_yau_variety
nodes.description: A smooth projective variety with trivial canonical bundle K_X = O_X and vanishing intermediate cohomology.

nodes.name: jacobian_of_curve
nodes.description: The abelian variety J(C) parametrizing degree-0 line bundles on a smooth curve C.

nodes.name: neron_model
nodes.description: A smooth group scheme over a Dedekind domain extending an abelian variety over the generic fiber (Neron)

nodes.name: serres_gaga
nodes.description: For a projective variety X over C, the categories of algebraic and analytic coherent sheaves are equivalent (Serre)

nodes.name: bezouts_theorem
nodes.description: Two projective plane curves of degrees d and e with no common component meet in exactly de points counted with multiplicity (Bezout)

nodes.name: finite_generation_of_canonical_ring
nodes.description: The canonical ring R(X, K_X) is finitely generated for any smooth projective variety of general type (Birkar, Cascini, Hacon, McKernan)

nodes.name: existence_of_hilbert_schemes
nodes.description: Hilbert schemes exist as projective schemes and represent the Hilbert functor (Grothendieck)

nodes.name: deligne_mumford_irreducibility
nodes.description: The moduli space M_g is irreducible of dimension 3g-3 for g >= 2 (Deligne, Mumford)

nodes.name: birational_geometry_program
nodes.function_signature: (Algebraic variety X) → (Minimal model or Mori fiber space)
nodes.description: The study of varieties up to birational equivalence, including the minimal model program and classification.

nodes.name: grothendieck_cohomology_methods
nodes.function_signature: (Scheme X, Sheaf F) → (Cohomology groups H^i(X,F))
nodes.description: Using sheaf cohomology and derived categories as the primary computational tool in algebraic geometry.

nodes.name: deformation_theory
nodes.function_signature: (Algebraic structure S₀) → (Family of deformations, Obstruction classes)
nodes.description: Studying families of algebraic structures by analyzing infinitesimal deformations and obstruction classes.

nodes.name: grobner_basis_computation
nodes.function_signature: (Polynomial ideal I) → (Gröbner basis, Reduced forms)
nodes.description: Using monomial orderings to compute in polynomial rings and solve systems of polynomial equations algorithmically.

nodes.name: rational_point
nodes.description: A point on a variety V defined over a field K with all coordinates in K.

nodes.name: diophantine_equation
nodes.description: A polynomial equation f(x_1,...,x_n) = 0 to be solved in integers or rationals.

nodes.name: height_of_rational_point
nodes.description: A measure of the arithmetic complexity of a rational point, H(p/q) = max(.

nodes.name: weil_height
nodes.description: The logarithmic height h(P) defined using the product formula over all places, well-defined on projective space.

nodes.name: neron_tate_height
nodes.description: The canonical height hat{h} on an abelian variety, a quadratic form refining the Weil height (Neron, Tate)

nodes.name: good_reduction
nodes.description: An elliptic curve E/Q has good reduction at p if E mod p is still smooth.

nodes.name: bad_reduction
nodes.description: An elliptic curve E/Q has bad reduction at p if E mod p acquires a singularity.

nodes.name: etale_topology
nodes.description: A Grothendieck topology on schemes where covering maps are etale morphisms (local isomorphisms) rather than open inclusions.

nodes.name: etale_morphism
nodes.description: A flat unramified morphism of finite type between schemes, the algebraic analogue of a local diffeomorphism.

nodes.name: etale_fundamental_group
nodes.description: The profinite group pi_1^et(X, x) classifying finite etale covers of a scheme, generalizing the topological fundamental group.

nodes.name: shimura_variety
nodes.description: A higher-dimensional generalization of modular curves arising from quotients of symmetric domains by arithmetic groups.

nodes.name: newform
nodes.description: A normalized eigenform for all Hecke operators in the new subspace of S_k(Gamma_0(N))

nodes.name: automorphic_form
nodes.description: A generalization of modular forms to reductive groups over adeles, the central object of the Langlands program.

nodes.name: selmer_group
nodes.description: A subgroup of H^1(Gal(Q-bar/Q), E[n]) controlling the n-descent on an elliptic curve, containing the image of E(Q)/nE(Q)

nodes.name: bsd_order_of_vanishing
nodes.description: The order of vanishing of L(E,s) at s=1, conjectured to equal the rank of E(Q)

nodes.name: motive
nodes.description: A conjectural universal cohomological object associated to a variety, from which all cohomology theories are derived (Grothendieck)

nodes.name: l_function_of_motive
nodes.description: The L-function associated to a motive, unifying Hasse-Weil L-functions, Artin L-functions, and automorphic L-functions.

nodes.name: brauer_manin_obstruction
nodes.description: The obstruction to the Hasse principle arising from elements of the Brauer group of a variety (Manin)

nodes.name: tamagawa_number
nodes.description: The volume of G(A)/G(K) with respect to canonical measures on adelic points of an algebraic group G.

nodes.name: birch_swinnerton_dyer_conjecture
nodes.description: The rank of E(Q) equals the order of vanishing of L(E,s) at s=1, with an explicit formula for the leading coefficient (Birch, Swinnerton-Dyer; largely open)

nodes.name: tate_conjecture
nodes.description: The rank of the group of algebraic cycles modulo homological equivalence equals the order of the pole of the L-function of H^{2i} (Tate; open in general)

nodes.name: finiteness_of_sha_conjecture
nodes.description: The Tate-Shafarevich group Sha(E/K) is finite for every elliptic curve over a number field (widely believed, open in general)

nodes.name: descent_method
nodes.function_signature: (Bounding the rank of E(K) by computing the Selmer group through Galois cohomology and local analysis.) → (Result)
nodes.description: Bounding the rank of E(K) by computing the Selmer group through Galois cohomology and local analysis.

nodes.name: height_machine
nodes.function_signature: (Using height functions and their properties (Northcott) → (Result)
nodes.description: Using height functions and their properties (Northcott, descent) to prove finiteness and boundedness results for rational points.

nodes.name: deformation_of_galois_representations
nodes.function_signature: (Galois representation ρ̄) → (Universal deformation ring, Modularity)
nodes.description: Taylor-Wiles method of studying the moduli of Galois representations to prove modularity lifting theorems.

nodes.name: iwasawa_theory
nodes.function_signature: (Number field K, Prime p) → (Growth of class groups in ℤ_p-extensions)
nodes.description: Studying the growth of arithmetic invariants (class groups, Selmer groups) in towers of number fields using p-adic L-functions.

nodes.name: group_representation
nodes.description: A homomorphism rho: G -> GL(V) from a group G to the group of invertible linear maps on a vector space V.

nodes.name: degree_of_representation
nodes.description: The dimension of the vector space V on which G acts.

nodes.name: subrepresentation
nodes.description: A G-invariant subspace W of V with the restricted action.

nodes.name: direct_sum_of_representations
nodes.description: The representation on V + W with G acting on each summand independently.

nodes.name: tensor_product_of_representations
nodes.description: The representation on V tensor W with g acting as rho_1(g) tensor rho_2(g)

nodes.name: character_of_representation
nodes.description: The function chi_rho(g) = Tr(rho(g)), a class function on G that determines the representation up to isomorphism.

nodes.name: class_function
nodes.description: A function f: G -> C constant on conjugacy classes.

nodes.name: trivial_representation
nodes.description: The one-dimensional representation sending every group element to the identity.

nodes.name: representation_ring
nodes.description: The Grothendieck ring R(G) of virtual representations under direct sum and tensor product.

nodes.name: induced_representation
nodes.description: The representation Ind_H^G(sigma) = C[G] tensor_{C[H]} V for a representation sigma of a subgroup H.

nodes.name: restricted_representation
nodes.description: The representation Res_H^G(rho) obtained by restricting a G-representation to a subgroup H.

nodes.name: lie_algebra_representation
nodes.description: A Lie algebra homomorphism rho: g -> gl(V), equivalently a g-module structure on V.

nodes.name: weight_of_representation
nodes.description: An eigenvalue lambda in h^* for the action of a Cartan subalgebra h on a representation.

nodes.name: weight_space
nodes.description: The eigenspace V_lambda = {v in V : h.v = lambda(h)v for all h in h} for a weight lambda.

nodes.name: fundamental_weight
nodes.description: The weight omega_i dual to the simple coroots: omega_i(h_j) = delta_{ij}.

nodes.name: positive_root
nodes.description: A root that is a non-negative integer linear combination of simple roots.

nodes.name: simple_root
nodes.description: An indecomposable positive root, forming a basis for the root system.

nodes.name: category_O
nodes.description: The category of finitely generated g-modules that are h-semisimple and locally n^+-finite (Bernstein-Gelfand-Gelfand)

nodes.name: isotypic_component
nodes.description: The sum of all irreducible subrepresentations isomorphic to a given irreducible, the multiplicity space times the irreducible.

nodes.name: multiplicity_of_irreducible
nodes.description: The number of times an irreducible representation appears in the decomposition of a given representation.

nodes.name: weyl_character
nodes.description: The character of the irreducible highest-weight representation L(lambda), given by the Weyl character formula.

nodes.name: formal_character
nodes.description: The element sum_{mu} dim(V_mu) e^mu in the group ring of the weight lattice, encoding the weight space dimensions.

nodes.name: jordan_holder_multiplicity
nodes.description: The multiplicity [M:L] of a simple module L in a composition series of M, independent of the series chosen.

nodes.name: kazhdan_lusztig_polynomial
nodes.description: The polynomial P_{y,w}(q) for pairs of Weyl group elements encoding multiplicities in the BGG resolution and intersection cohomology (Kazhdan, Lusztig)

nodes.name: bgg_resolution
nodes.description: The resolution of a finite-dimensional irreducible module by Verma modules, with maps indexed by the Bruhat order (Bernstein, Gelfand, Gelfand)

nodes.name: harish_chandra_module
nodes.description: A (g, K)-module with finite K-multiplicities, the algebraic counterpart of a unitary representation of a real reductive group.

nodes.name: langlands_parameter
nodes.description: The data (M, sigma, nu) classifying irreducible admissible representations of a reductive group via the Langlands classification.

nodes.name: schurs_lemma
nodes.description: Any G-equivariant map between irreducible representations is either zero or an isomorphism; over C, the endomorphism ring is C (Schur)

nodes.name: maschkes_theorem
nodes.description: Every finite-dimensional representation of a finite group over a field of characteristic not dividing.

nodes.name: number_of_irreducibles_equals_conjugacy_classes
nodes.description: The number of irreducible representations of a finite group equals the number of its conjugacy classes.

nodes.name: weyl_character_formula
nodes.description: The character of the irreducible representation L(lambda) is sum_{w in W} (-1)^{l(w)} e^{w(lambda+rho)} / sum_{w in W} (-1)^{l(w)} e^{w(rho)} (Weyl)

nodes.name: kazhdan_lusztig_conjecture
nodes.description: The multiplicity [M(w.lambda):L(y.lambda)] equals P_{y,w}(1), proved by Beilinson-Bernstein and Brylinski-Kashiwara using D-modules.

nodes.name: character_methods
nodes.function_signature: (Group representation) → (Character table, Decomposition into irreducibles)
nodes.description: Using characters to decompose representations, compute multiplicities, and prove structural theorems about groups.

nodes.name: induction_restriction_technique
nodes.function_signature: (Representation of subgroup H) → (Induced representation of G)
nodes.description: Systematically using Ind and Res to relate representations of a group to those of subgroups.

nodes.name: geometric_representation_theory
nodes.function_signature: (Algebraic variety/stack) → (Representation via geometric objects)
nodes.description: Realizing representations via geometric objects: D-modules, perverse sheaves, intersection cohomology on flag varieties.

nodes.name: crystal_base_method
nodes.function_signature: (Quantum group U_q(g)) → (Crystal basis, Combinatorial representation theory)
nodes.description: Kashiwara's approach to representation theory using crystal bases and combinatorial structures at q=0.

nodes.name: presentation_of_group
nodes.description: A description G = <S.

nodes.name: word_metric
nodes.description: The metric d(g,h) on a finitely generated group defined as the minimal length of a word representing g^{-1}h in the generators.

nodes.name: conjugacy_problem
nodes.description: The decision problem of determining whether two given elements of a group are conjugate.

nodes.name: isomorphism_problem
nodes.description: The decision problem of determining whether two finitely presented groups are isomorphic.

nodes.name: free_group
