nodes.description: Geodesics of a one-sided invariant Riemannian metric on a Lie group satisfy the Euler equations on its Lie algebra, unifying rigid-body rotation with ideal fluid motion on the volume-preserving diffeomorphism group.

nodes.name: Lie–Poisson structure on the dual of a Lie algebra
nodes.description: The natural Poisson bracket on the dual of a Lie algebra induced by the Lie bracket, whose symplectic leaves are the coadjoint orbits.

nodes.name: Small denominators problem
nodes.description: The obstruction in perturbation theory of quasi-periodic motion arising from near-resonant frequency combinations k·ω that can make formal series diverge unless the frequencies satisfy Diophantine conditions.

nodes.name: Adiabatic invariant
nodes.function_signature: (slowly varying Hamiltonian) → (approximately conserved action variable)
nodes.description: Identifies the action variable of a one-degree-of-freedom oscillator as approximately conserved under slow variation of the system's parameters.

nodes.name: Canonical perturbation theory
nodes.function_signature: (near-integrable Hamiltonian) → (canonical transformation simplifying it order by order)
nodes.description: Constructs canonical transformations by generating functions to remove the perturbation order by order in action-angle variables for a nearly integrable Hamiltonian system.

nodes.name: Caustic (Lagrangian singularity)
nodes.description: The singular set of the projection of a Lagrangian submanifold to configuration space, where infinitely many rays or trajectories focus and short-wave amplitudes blow up.

nodes.name: Short-wave (WKB) asymptotics with Maslov index
nodes.function_signature: (Lagrangian submanifold, small parameter) → (asymptotic oscillatory solution)
nodes.description: Constructs short-wavelength asymptotic solutions of wave equations from a Lagrangian submanifold, with phase shifts at caustics fixed by the Maslov index to make the global expansion well defined.

nodes.name: Extended phase space
nodes.description: The phase space enlarged by the time variable and its conjugate momentum -H, on which a time-dependent Hamiltonian system becomes autonomous and the Poincaré–Cartan form is the canonical 1-form.

nodes.name: Torsion coefficients of homology
nodes.description: The torsion part of a finitely generated homology group, given by the cyclic factors ℤ/k_i in its decomposition into free and torsion subgroups.

nodes.name: Euler–Poincaré theorem
nodes.type_signature: χ(K) = Σ_n (−1)^n dim C_n = Σ_n (−1)^n b_n
nodes.description: The alternating sum of the numbers of n-simplices of a complex equals the alternating sum of its Betti numbers, so the Euler characteristic is a homotopy invariant computable from either chains or homology.

nodes.name: Maurer–Cartan form
nodes.description: The canonical left-invariant Lie-algebra-valued one-form on a Lie group G that maps each tangent vector back to the identity tangent space and satisfies dθ + ½[θ,θ]=0.

nodes.name: Codifferential (adjoint exterior derivative)
nodes.description: The formal adjoint of the exterior derivative defined via the Hodge star, lowering form degree by one and combining with d to give the Hodge Laplacian Δ = dδ + δd.

nodes.name: Dolbeault operators ∂ and ∂̄
nodes.description: The holomorphic and antiholomorphic components of the exterior derivative on a complex manifold, splitting d on the (p,q)-bidegree decomposition and each squaring to zero.

nodes.name: Chern connection
nodes.type_signature: ∇ on holomorphic Hermitian bundle, compatible with h and ∂̄
nodes.description: The unique connection on a holomorphic vector bundle that is compatible with the Hermitian metric and whose (0,1)-part equals the Dolbeault operator ∂̄.

nodes.name: Reduction of the structure group
nodes.type_signature: H ⊂ G subbundle of principal G-bundle
nodes.description: A reduction of a principal G-bundle to a subgroup H ⊂ G, given by an H-subbundle of the total space, whose existence encodes geometric structure such as orientation, metric, or spin.

nodes.name: Universal bundle
nodes.type_signature: EG → BG, with [X,BG] ≅ {principal G-bundles on X}
nodes.description: The principal G-bundle over the classifying space BG with contractible total space EG, from which every principal G-bundle on a space X is obtained by pullback of a homotopy-unique classifying map.

nodes.name: Fundamental vector field
nodes.type_signature: A ∈ 𝔤 ↦ A^# ∈ Γ(TP), A^#_p = d/dt|_0 (p·exp(tA))
nodes.description: The vertical vector field on a principal bundle generated by a Lie algebra element through the right action, giving the canonical isomorphism between 𝔤 and the vertical subspace at each point.

nodes.name: Vertical subspace of a principal bundle
nodes.type_signature: V_p P = ker(π_*: T_p P → T_{π(p)}M)
nodes.description: The subspace of the tangent space to a principal bundle tangent to the fibre, namely the kernel of the projection's differential, isomorphic to the Lie algebra via fundamental vector fields.

nodes.name: Ehresmann connection
nodes.description: A smooth right-invariant choice of horizontal subspace complementary to the vertical subspace at every point of a principal bundle, equivalent to a connection one-form.

nodes.name: Local connection form (gauge potential)
nodes.description: The pullback of the connection one-form by a local section, identified physically with the gauge potential, transforming inhomogeneously across overlapping trivializations.

nodes.name: Local field strength
nodes.description: The pullback of the curvature two-form by a local section, equal to dA + A∧A, transforming homogeneously (covariantly) under gauge transformations.

nodes.name: Topological instanton charge
nodes.description: The integer-valued second Chern number of a gauge field on a four-manifold, classifying instanton sectors as the integral of tr(F∧F).

nodes.name: Berry phase
nodes.description: The geometric phase acquired by an adiabatically transported quantum eigenstate around a closed loop in parameter space, equal to the holonomy of the Berry connection.

nodes.name: Berry connection and curvature
nodes.description: The U(1) connection one-form built from a parameter-dependent quantum eigenstate and its exterior-derivative curvature, whose loop integral gives the Berry phase.

nodes.name: Spin structure
nodes.type_signature: Spin(n)-bundle P̃ → P_SO(n), 2-fold cover on fibres
nodes.description: A lift of the orthonormal frame bundle of an oriented Riemannian manifold to a principal Spin(n)-bundle double-covering it fibrewise, existing precisely when the second Stiefel–Whitney class vanishes.

nodes.name: Analytical index
nodes.type_signature: ind(D) = dim ker D − dim coker D
nodes.description: The integer difference between the dimensions of the kernel and cokernel of an elliptic operator, the analytic side of the Atiyah–Singer index theorem.

nodes.name: Topological index
nodes.description: The integer computed from characteristic classes and the principal symbol of an elliptic operator, equated to the analytical index by the Atiyah–Singer theorem.

nodes.name: Chiral (abelian) anomaly
nodes.description: The quantum non-conservation of the axial current in a gauge background, whose anomaly density equals a characteristic-class form integrating to the Dirac index.

nodes.name: Non-abelian gauge anomaly
nodes.description: The breakdown of gauge invariance of the effective action under infinitesimal non-abelian gauge transformations, measured by the consistent anomaly functional.

nodes.name: Gravitational anomaly
nodes.description: The quantum violation of general-coordinate (diffeomorphism) invariance, manifesting as non-conservation of the energy–momentum tensor for chiral fields in certain dimensions.

nodes.name: Anomaly polynomial
nodes.type_signature: I_{2n+2} = closed (2n+2)-form in F and R
nodes.description: The closed characteristic-class form in even dimension whose descent gives the consistent gauge and gravitational anomalies of a chiral theory in two dimensions lower.

nodes.name: Consistent versus covariant anomaly
nodes.description: The distinction between the anomaly satisfying the Wess–Zumino consistency condition and the manifestly gauge-covariant anomaly, differing by a local counterterm (the Bardeen–Zumino polynomial).

nodes.name: McKean–Singer formula
nodes.description: The index of a Dirac-type operator equals the supertrace of the heat kernel for any positive time, the basis of the supersymmetric heat-kernel proof of the index theorem.

nodes.name: Nambu–Goto action
nodes.description: The relativistic string action proportional to the proper area of the worldsheet, given by the square root of the determinant of the induced metric.

nodes.name: Polyakov action
nodes.description: The string action with an independent worldsheet metric γ_{ab} as an auxiliary field, classically equivalent to the Nambu–Goto action and quantizable.

nodes.name: Worldsheet diffeomorphism and Weyl invariance
nodes.description: The local symmetries of the Polyakov action under worldsheet reparametrizations and rescalings of the worldsheet metric, used to fix conformal gauge.

nodes.name: Conformal gauge
nodes.description: The gauge choice fixing the worldsheet metric to be conformally flat, reducing the Polyakov action to a free-field form with residual conformal symmetry.

nodes.name: Conformal anomaly (central charge)
nodes.description: The quantum anomaly in worldsheet Weyl/conformal symmetry encoded by the central charge c appearing in the Virasoro algebra of the energy–momentum modes.

nodes.name: Critical dimension
nodes.description: The spacetime dimension in which the total Virasoro central charge cancels (matter plus ghosts), removing the conformal anomaly: 26 for the bosonic string and 10 for the superstring.

nodes.name: Faddeev–Popov ghosts
nodes.description: The anticommuting ghost fields b and c introduced when gauge-fixing the worldsheet symmetries, contributing central charge −26 that must cancel the matter contribution.

nodes.name: String mass spectrum and tachyon
nodes.type_signature: α'M² = N − a, ground state M² < 0
nodes.description: The mass levels of string excitations set by the number operator and normal-ordering constant, whose lowest state is the tachyon with negative mass-squared in the bosonic string.

nodes.name: Moduli space of Riemann surfaces
nodes.description: The space of inequivalent complex structures on a genus-g surface, the quotient of Teichmüller space by the mapping class group, over which string amplitudes are integrated.

nodes.name: Homotopy classification of topological defects
nodes.description: The classification of stable topological defects of an ordered medium with order-parameter space G/H by the homotopy groups π_n(G/H), with domain walls, strings, monopoles given by π_0, π_1, π_2.

nodes.name: Fujikawa method
nodes.function_signature: (path-integral measure under chiral transformation) → (anomaly Jacobian)
nodes.description: A technique deriving the chiral anomaly as the non-invariance (Jacobian) of the fermionic path-integral measure under a chiral transformation, regularized to a characteristic-class density.

nodes.name: Stora–Zumino descent equations
nodes.function_signature: (invariant 2n+2-form I) → (Chern–Simons 2n+1-form ω, anomaly 2n-form G)
nodes.description: A chain of equations dω_{2n+1}=I_{2n+2}, δω_{2n+1}=dω_{2n}^1 that descends an anomaly polynomial through Chern–Simons forms to obtain the consistent gauge anomaly.

nodes.name: Supersymmetric proof of the index theorem
nodes.function_signature: (supersymmetric quantum mechanics on M) → (Â-genus / index density)
nodes.description: A technique computing the Dirac index via the t→0 limit of the supersymmetric path integral (McKean–Singer supertrace), localizing onto the characteristic-class integrand.

nodes.name: BRST quantization of the string
nodes.function_signature: (gauge-fixed worldsheet action with ghosts) → (nilpotent BRST charge Q, Q²=0)
nodes.description: A technique quantizing the string by constructing a nilpotent BRST charge from matter and ghost fields, whose cohomology at the right ghost number selects the physical state spectrum.

nodes.function_signature: (Dirac-type operator D, time t) → (Str e^{-tD²} = index density)
nodes.description: Computes the index of a Dirac-type operator by evaluating the t-independent supertrace of the heat kernel and taking its short-time asymptotic expansion to extract the local characteristic-class index density (McKean–Singer).

nodes.function_signature: (connection one-form, loop γ) → (holonomy / gauge-transformed potential)
nodes.description: Parallel-transports along loops and applies gauge transformations to a connection, producing holonomy phases and the inhomogeneous transformation law of the local gauge potential.

nodes.function_signature: (simplicial complex K) → (Euler characteristic χ = Σ(-1)^n c_n)
nodes.description: Computes the Euler characteristic of a complex as the alternating sum of simplex counts and equates it, via homology, to the alternating sum of Betti numbers.

nodes.function_signature: (order-parameter space G/H, dimension n) → (π_n(G/H) defect classes)
nodes.description: Classifies stable topological defects of an ordered medium by computing the homotopy groups of the order-parameter coset space G/H.

nodes.function_signature: (gauge-fixed worldsheet CFT, ghosts) → (central charge c, critical dimension)
nodes.description: Computes the total Virasoro central charge from matter and Faddeev–Popov ghost sectors and imposes its cancellation to fix the critical spacetime dimension and remove the conformal anomaly.
